edits: In fiscal 2023 the United States disbursed about **$71.9 billion** in foreign aid. USAID moved about **$43.8 billion** of that — three of every five dollars.
In fiscal 2023 the United States disbursed about **$80.5 billion** in foreign assistance, by ForeignAssistance.gov’s current data.

Cash assistance in the West Bank and Gaza: about **$36 million** in fiscal 2024 to four NGOs, with fraud risk USAID did not identify. Humanitarian awards in that theater: **$650 million**, eighteen awards, vetting that still left a diversion risk. The spring 2026 semiannual report: **$25.9 billion** audited, convictions, debarments, NGO officers sentenced for laundering grant money.

[Cash assistance in the West Bank and Gaza](https://oig.usaid.gov/sites/default/files/2026-05/Audit%20of%20USAID%20Cash%20Assistance%20to%20West%20Bank%20Gaza%20%20%289-000-26-002-P%29.pdf): about **$36 million** in fiscal 2024 to four NGOs, with key fraud risks USAID did not identify. [Humanitarian awards in that theater](https://oig.usaid.gov/sites/default/files/2026-05/Final%20Audit%20Report%20-%20West%20Bank%20and%20Gaza%20Partner%20Vetting%20Audit%20%288-294-26-003-P%29_0.pdf): **$650 million** across eighteen awards, with selective partner vetting that the auditor said could increase the risk of diversion.
That is taxpayer money into party-aligned shops.
NED funds four core institutes, including those two party-affiliated ones.
